overview: This one-page file consists of a State Department list-of-papers sheet for the subject “Life Insurance—Kwangtung Leased Territory.” It records a despatch numbered 120 from Dairen, attributed to Coville and dated December 13, 1920, which supplied brief life-insurance statistics for 1918–1919; the OCR’s “1978-9” is an evident misreading.

subfiles.about: The sheet indexes a Dairen despatch containing brief life-insurance statistics for the Kwantung Leased Territory for 1918–1919.
subfiles.summary: This filing sheet identifies the subject as life insurance in the Kwangtung Leased Territory. It records Dairen despatch no. 120, associated with Coville and dated December 13, 1920, and indicates distribution or routing to “Ac/c, PA, FP.” The despatch itself is described as providing brief statistics for 1918–1919, correcting the OCR’s anachronistic “1978-9.”

interest: The page is useful chiefly as archival evidence for a substantive report that is not reproduced in the supplied file: it preserves the report’s number, origin, date, authorial association, routing codes, and subject. It also points to an early attempt by American officials to collect economic and insurance data in the Japanese-administered Kwantung Leased Territory. The coexistence of “Kwangtung” and “Kwantung,” together with the historical name “Dairen” for modern Dalian, is valuable for cataloguing and search normalization.
